title: A Chicago teacher's students talk about the Hill
summary: Ky Dickens tells of A Chicago teacher's students talk about the Hill, about c. 2023 at Chicago, Illinois, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then I met a teacher in Chicago and her kids were talking about the hill

plain: Ky Dickens is a filmmaker behind a documentary series about nonspeaking children who are said to read minds. She says that around 2023 she met a teacher in Chicago whose students talked about something they called "the hill," which other children in her work had also described. If true, it would suggest children who had never met were sharing the same inner experience.
